91	are the index discipline of `Scheme.CechPic`: the index type is the carrier of `X` (so
92	everything stays in `Type u`), refinement is indexwise, and pointwise `⊓` makes the
93	refinement order directed. -/
94	structure PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
95	  /-- The member of the cover attached to a point. -/
96	  opens : X → X.Opens
97	  /-- Each point lies in its member. -/
98	  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x
99	
100	namespace PointedCover
101	
102	@[ext]
103	lemma ext {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : ∀ x, 𝒰.opens x = 𝒱.opens x) : 𝒰 = 𝒱 := by
104	  cases 𝒰; cases 𝒱
105	  simpa using funext h
106	
107	instance : SemilatticeInf X.PointedCover where
108	  le 𝒱 𝒰 := ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x
109	  le_refl 𝒰 x := le_rfl
110	  le_trans 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := (h₁ x).trans (h₂ x)
111	  le_antisymm 𝒰 𝒱 h₁ h₂ := ext fun x ↦ le_antisymm (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
112	  inf 𝒰 𝒱 :=
113	    { opens := fun x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x
114	      mem_opens := fun x ↦ ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, 𝒱.mem_opens x⟩ }
115	  inf_le_left 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_left
116	  inf_le_right 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_right
117	  le_inf 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := le_inf (h₁ x) (h₂ x)

21	about the underlying *topological* map, while everything the Picard side produces is a
22	morphism of schemes.

25	
26	> `surjective_of_forall_exists_residueField_lift` — if for every `y : Y` some
27	> `q : Spec (Y.residueField y) ⟶ X` satisfies `q ≫ f = Y.fromSpecResidueField y`, then
28	> `f.base` is surjective.

31	`Y.fromSpecResidueField y` is `{y}`, and `Spec κ(y)` is nonempty because `κ(y)` is a field,
32	so any point of `Spec κ(y)` maps into the fibre.  Composed with the DJ-0 lemmas this gives
33	the Jacobian datum producers in the shape the classical argument actually delivers: a
34	*per-point lift*, which is what `exists_effective_of_picClass` hands back.

38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_of_forall_exists_residueField_lift` — the conversion.
39	  Pure scheme topology; no curve, no Picard functor, no divisor scheme.
40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.quasiCompact_of_forall_residueField_lift_from_divScheme` — DJ-1's qc
41	  step from per-point lifts.

152	    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ J.left)

154	      DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂,
155	      q ≫ abel = J.left.fromSpecResidueField y) :

164	    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ J.left)
